Remark
[Commutator on general tensors] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0299 1. Section A.6\group commuting-covariant-derivatives

If $A$ is any $(p,q)$-tensor field, then \[ [ abla _i, abla _j]A^{\ell _1\cdots \ell _q}{}_{k_1\cdots k_p} \equiv abla _i abla _j A^{\ell _1\cdots \ell _q}{}_{k_1\cdots k_p} - abla _j abla _i A^{\ell _1\cdots \ell _q}{}_{k_1\cdots k_p} \] \[ = \sum _{r=1}^q R^{\ell _r}{}_{ijm}\, A^{\ell _1\cdots \ell _{r-1}m\ell _{r+1}\cdots \ell _q}{}_{k_1\cdots k_p} - \sum _{s=1}^p R^{m}{}_{ijk_s}\, A^{\ell _1\cdots \ell _q}{}_{k_1\cdots k_{s-1}mk_{s+1}\cdots k_p}. \]
